test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a square table not facing the centre. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. L is sitting to the immediate right of P. O is sitting to the immediate right of L. O is sitting between L and S. S is sitting to the immediate left of R. M is sitting between Q and R. N is sitting to the immediate right of Q and immediate left of P. Who is sitting second left from N?
solution:
Given: L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a square table not facing the centre.

Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

1) L is sitting to the immediate right of P.

2) O is sitting to the immediate right of L.

3) O is sitting between L and S.

4) S is sitting to the immediate left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/340ab537896235b57a5afe09b8cdacd18113f46e2d10a803bb845f65222e1019.png] 

5) M is sitting between Q and R.

6) N is sitting to the immediate right of Q and immediate left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4402a765b60a66fd49fd1e67d5cec42aa2034484e79fe2d64a5185029e9adc9b.png] 

Here, 'M' is sitting second left from N.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
